headline_marked: 1,938 iPhones seized: [[6 Chinese nationals arrested]] in Cox's Bazar
headline: 1,938 iPhones seized: 6 Chinese nationals arrested in Cox's Bazar
summary: Police raided a hotel on the Marine Drive road, uncovering a massive haul of electronics and communication equipment used for online fraud.
details: Police arrested six Chinese nationals during a raid on Hotel Sea Palace in Cox's Bazar. The operation uncovered 1,938 iPhones, 40 laptops, and various communication tools.

The arrests were made following a tip-off from Dhaka police and a complaint filed at the Ramu police station. The suspects were brought before the Cox's Bazar Amli Court on Friday afternoon and sent to jail.
According to police, the group had been operating from two hotels along the Marine Drive road for at least two months. They are accused of running online-based fraud operations.
The suspects have been charged under the Cyber Security Act. Police officials stated that they are continuing their operations to bring other members of the fraud ring to justice.
caption:
Nearly 2,000 iPhones and 40 laptops seized in a single raid! 📱

Six Chinese nationals have been arrested in Cox's Bazar for running a massive online fraud operation.

Police arrested six Chinese nationals during a raid on Hotel Sea Palace in Cox's Bazar. The operation uncovered 1,938 iPhones, 40 laptops, and various communication tools.

The arrests were made following a tip-off from Dhaka police and a complaint filed at the Ramu police station. The suspects were brought before the Cox's Bazar Amli Court on Friday afternoon and sent to jail.

According to police, the group had been operating from two hotels along the Marine Drive road for at least two months. They are accused of running online-based fraud operations.

The suspects have been charged under the Cyber Security Act. Police officials stated that they are continuing their operations to bring other members of the fraud ring to justice.

headline: Man posts video of firing pistol after Jubodal worker killed in Raozan
summary: A man identified as Md. Raihan, an associate of fugitive terrorist Sajjad Ali, shared a video of himself firing a gun on Facebook.
details: A man named Md. Raihan posted a video on his Facebook story showing him firing a pistol shortly after a Jubodal worker was shot dead in Raozan, Chattogram.
